title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student provides the correct expression for c_1 as derived from entropy considerations.

title: Entropy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly applies the relationship between heat capacity and entropy, C = T dS/dT.

title: Integral Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student sets up the integral for the total change in entropy correctly, S(infinity) - S(0) = integral of C/T dT.

title: Limits of Integration
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly identifies the limits of integration for the entropy calculation.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student checks that the units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student makes a sign mistake or miscalculates the integral leading to an incorrect final answer.

title: Understanding of Concepts
description: Optional Criteria: The student demonstrates a clear understanding of the physical concepts of entropy and heat capacity.
